relations.evidence: Some years ago, I asked Stefania Merzagora, a Sanskritist and Tibetologist, to edit the Tibetan translation of the Sekoddeśatīkā. She read- ily agreed and proved to be an enthusiastic, competent and painstaking collaborator.
